name: gable_roof
description: Gable roof (人字顶) built from stair rows with automatic step-in (收分), ridge slab, and optional solid gable-end triangle fill. V2: stair facing is geometrically derived per slope (north rows face south, south rows face north, half=bottom, ridge sealed).
when_to_use: Any building whose style card says roof.type = gable. Place walls first, then run this with origin = the wall footprint's north-west corner and y = first layer ABOVE the top wall block. DIRECTION STATES ARE DERIVED BY THE SCRIPT — never hand-edit facing/half in the output JSON; change params and re-run instead (禁止手改方向状态).

origin.notes: world coords of the wall footprint corner the roof sits on; y = roof base layer

height.notes: 0 = auto 45-degree rise from span+overhang; set explicitly for shallower/steeper pitches

axis.notes: ridge direction; the gable ends face the OTHER axis

material.notes: any *_stairs from the style card's roof list

ridge_material.notes: slab used on the ridge row

end_fill.notes: wall material to fill the triangular gable ends; empty = open gables
